name: enable_module
label: Enable module
help_text: Show or hide this module on the page.

name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Replaces the auto-generated module ID used in HTML and for CSS/JS targeting. Leave blank to use the default.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Additional CSS classes for styling this module.

name: banner_image
label: Banner image
help_text: Override the post featured image with a custom banner. Both the toggle must be ON and an image must be set in XL Banner Image for the override to take effect. Image sizing: if the editor shows "Responsive sizing isn't available," use exact sizing — both work here. To revert to automatic sizing, remove the image and add it again.

children.name: override_banner_image
children.label: Override banner image
children.help_text: Enable to use a custom banner image. When disabled, the post featured image is used. An image must also be set in XL Banner Image below for the override to apply.

children.name: banner_image_xl
children.label: XL Banner Image
children.help_text: Primary banner image; required for override to apply. Fallback for smaller breakpoints if not overridden. For retina use 2x display width. If HubSpot shows "Responsive sizing isn't available," you can click "Use exact sizing" — the banner will display the same. Both automatic and exact sizing work in this module. To switch back to automatic sizing, remove the image and add it again.

children.name: override_lg_banner_image
children.label: Override Desktop Image
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: banner_image_lg
children.label: Desktop Image
children.help_text: Image when Override Desktop Image is enabled.

children.name: override_md_banner_image
children.label: Override Tablet Image
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: banner_image_md
children.label: Tablet Image
children.help_text: Image when Override Tablet Image is enabled.

children.name: override_sm_banner_image
children.label: Override Mobile Image
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: banner_image_sm
children.label: Mobile Image
children.help_text: Image when Override Mobile Image is enabled.

name: show_post_meta
label: Show post meta
help_text: Display title, tags, and author line. When off, only the banner image is shown.

name: show_title
label: Show title
help_text: Display the post title. When off, only tags and author line are shown (if enabled).

children.name: override_title
children.label: Override title
children.help_text: Enable to use a custom title or to change font settings while still using the page title. When disabled, the blog post page title is used with theme defaults. Recommended: leave set to Auto (off) to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_text
children.label: Heading
children.help_text: Custom title text when Override title is on. Leave blank to keep the page title but use the Size, Display Size, Align, and Color settings below. Recommended: leave set to Auto (override off) to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_size
children.label: Size
children.help_text: HTML heading level (h1-h6). Recommended: leave set to Auto to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: How large the heading appears. Recommended: leave set to Auto to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_align
children.label: Align
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment of the title. Recommended: leave set to Auto to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_color
children.label: Color
children.help_text: Theme or custom color for the title. Recommended: leave set to Auto to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex with opacity when Color is Custom. Recommended: leave Color set to Auto to use theme defaults.

children.name: heading_text_wrap
children.label: Heading text wrap
children.help_text: How heading lines wrap. Balance evens line lengths (theme default); Auto uses browser default; Initial resets to initial value. Recommended: leave set to Balance to match theme.

name: post_meta
label: Tags and author
help_text: Show tags ("Posted in: ") and/or author line ("Posted by: Name on Date at Time") below the title. Only applies on blog post pages.

children.name: show_tags
children.label: Show tags
children.help_text: Display "Posted in: " followed by the post's tags directly below the title.

children.name: text_before_tags
children.label: Text before tags
children.help_text: Label shown before the tag list (e.g. "Posted in:"). Leave blank for no label.

children.name: link_tags
children.label: Link tags to tag pages
children.help_text: When on, each tag links to its tag listing page. When off, tags are plain text.

children.name: show_author_line
children.label: Show author line
children.help_text: Display "Posted by: Author Name" below the tags (or below the title if tags are off).

children.name: text_before_author
children.label: Text before author line
children.help_text: Label shown before the author name (e.g. "Posted by:"). Leave blank for no label.

children.name: show_author_date
children.label: Include date
children.help_text: Add " on [date]" to the author line (e.g. " on February 10, 2026").

children.name: show_author_time
children.label: Include time
children.help_text: Add " at [time]" to the author line (e.g. " at 10:23am"). Only available when Include date is on; time is never shown without date.

children.name: module_settings
children.label: Module Settings
children.help_text: Module height, vertical alignment, and spacing. Height cascades from XL unless overridden; vertical alignment defaults to middle with per-breakpoint overrides.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Adjust margins and padding for the module wrapper. Margin creates space between modules; padding creates space around the module content. Default is 25px left and right, 20px bottom. When the module has multiple spacing fields (e.g. Banner spacing), each applies to its intended target only.

children.name: module_height_xl_group
children.label: XL Module Height
children.help_text: Height settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: module_height_xl_mode
children.label: Minimum Height
children.help_text: Default: no minimum height (content dictates height). Custom Height: set a pixel value. Full Screen: 100vh minus header.

children.name: module_height_xl
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels. Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: vertical_align_xl
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment of content within the module at XL breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_lg_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_lg
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses XL value.

children.name: module_height_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_md_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_md
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_md
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_height_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_sm_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_sm
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_sm
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_background_settings
children.label: Module Background Settings
children.help_text: Configure the module background: Theme Color, Custom Color, or Gradient. This module does not support Image or Video background.

children.name: background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Choose the type of background: Theme Color, Custom Color (hex with opacity), or Gradient. This module does not support Image or Video background.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_custom
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Solid color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient colors and direction when Background Option is Gradient.

children.name: banner_spacing
children.label: Banner spacing
children.help_text: Margin and padding applied to the banner image container. Border radius uses the theme global setting unless overridden.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Adjust margin and padding for the banner. When no value is set, no extra spacing is applied.

children.name: override_banner_border_radius
children.label: Override border radius
children.help_text: When off, the banner uses the theme global border radius. When on, use the value below.

children.name: banner_border_radius
children.label: Border radius (px)
children.help_text: Border radius for the banner image when Override border radius is on.

children.name: banner_height_xl_group
children.label: XL Banner height
children.help_text: Min height: container never shorter than this; image can leave blank space below if shorter. Max height: image is cropped at the bottom if taller. Set both equal for a fixed height. 0 = no limit.

children.name: min_height_xl
children.label: Min height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum banner height. Use 0 for no minimum.

children.name: max_height_xl
children.label: Max height (px)
children.help_text: Maximum banner height; image crops from bottom if taller. Use 0 for no max (60vh fallback).

children.name: override_lg_banner_height
children.label: Override Desktop banner height
children.help_text: Use different min/max height for 992px–1199px.

children.name: override_md_banner_height
children.label: Override Tablet banner height
children.help_text: Use different min/max height for 768px–991px.

children.name: override_sm_banner_height
children.label: Override Mobile banner height
children.help_text: Use different min/max height for ≤767px.

children.name: content_colors
children.label: Content Colors
children.help_text: Text and link colors for the title block. Use when the background is Custom Color or when theme defaults do not apply correctly.

children.name: title_text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Theme defaults uses cascade. Choose a theme color or Custom for a hex color when the title block sits on custom/gradient/image backgrounds.

children.name: title_text_color_custom
children.label: Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Hex color when Text Color is Custom.

children.name: title_link_context
children.label: Link Colors
children.help_text: When links are on a dark background, choose Dark. When on light background, choose Light. Required when background is Custom Color (hex) since cascade cannot infer it.

children.name: post_meta_styling
children.label: Post Meta (Title Block)
children.help_text: Spacing, background, and border for the title block. Text and link colors are in Content Colors. Applies when Show post meta is on.

children.name: title_spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the title block wrapper.

children.name: title_border_radius_override
children.label: Override Border Radius
children.help_text: When disabled, uses the theme's global border radius. When enabled, set a custom radius.
